promotion_policy: STABLE zawiera tylko wersje potwierdzone w testach. Nowe funkcje i poprawki najpierw trafiają do BETA.
architecture: 10.10 BETA = frozen 10.6 beta + isolated fixes for native nick reply parsing, full B/I/U MIX and Ice Light readability. Friends are intentionally untouched.

versions.label: 10.10 BETA — 10.6 FIX PACK
versions.notes: Improves the frozen 10.6 branch without changing Friends. Removes SWIR mobile badges from inside native message nick elements so CZATeria can derive the correct nick for Odpowiedz/context menu. Replaces the old 2-style MIX with a shuffled full set of all 8 Bold/Italic/Underline combinations, advancing only after a successful send. Adds an Ice Light readability palette with dark blue, slate and teal text instead of white on light surfaces.
